requirement_summary.heading: feep.pbm
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
Programs that read this format should be as lenient as possible,
accepting anything that looks remotely like a bitmap.

requirement_summary.heading: feep.pbm
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
Therefore, if you want to produce an image that as many
 programs as possible can read, you should stick to the following subset.

requirement_summary.heading: feep.pbm
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
There must
be at least one character of white space between any two pixels, but there
is no maximum.

requirement_summary.heading: feep.pbm
requirement_summary.text_fragment: No line should be longer than 70 characters.

requirement_summary.heading: feep.pgm
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
Programs that read this format should be as lenient as possible,
accepting anything that looks remotely like a PGM image.

requirement_summary.heading: feep.pgm
requirement_summary.text_fragment: It should be noted that this format is egregiously inefficient.

requirement_summary.heading: feep.pgm
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
It should also be noted that files often conform to this format in
every respect except the precise semantics of the sample values.

requirement_summary.heading: feep.pgm
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
They are informally called PPM files, but to be
absolutely precise, you should indicate the variation from true PPM.

requirement_summary.heading: feep.pgm
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
Therefore, if you want to produce an image that as many
 programs as possible can read, you should stick to the following subset.

requirement_summary.heading: feep.pgm
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
There must
be at least one character of white space between any two samples, but there
is no maximum.

requirement_summary.heading: feep.pgm
requirement_summary.text_fragment: No line should be longer than 70 characters.

Programs that read this format should be as lenient as possible,
